meta.note: The colour values below are a reference rendering of the ANSI names flux emits. The user's terminal palette decides the real colour; two pairs fail contrast on light terminals and are flagged in their usage notes.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: The terminal background. Every specimen sits on it; ops never paints a background itself.

tokens.name: term-surface
tokens.usage: Window chrome around specimens in docs (title bar). Not emitted by ops.

tokens.name: term-border
tokens.usage: Hairline frame of a specimen window. Decorative only (below 3:1); never carries meaning.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Default foreground: the box frame (╭─ │ ╰─), the progress column (░ ▓ █), step icons and error text.

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: ANSI `dim`: an Info report result (`color_info`). 5.3:1 on term-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI `cyan`: every step label (`label_color`), and the whole running message (`{msg:.cyan}`).

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: ANSI `green`: the bottom-border summary, bold (`summary_color = "bold green"`), and an Ok report result. The summary is green on failure too.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI `yellow`: a Warning report result (`color_warning`).

tokens.name: ansi-yellow-dim
tokens.usage: ANSI `yellow dim`: every duration (`duration_color`) and the running elapsed time. 6.1:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: ANSI `red`: an Error report result (`color_error`).

tokens.name: ansi-red-dim
tokens.usage: ANSI `red dim`: the error bracket glyphs ├─ │ └─ (`error_block.color`). The only theme where an error is coloured. Used on glyphs, not text.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI `magenta`: the braille spinner (`{spinner:.magenta}`).

tokens.name: ansi-bright-white
tokens.usage: ANSI `bright_white`, bold: the plan title in the top border (`header_color`). FAILS on light terminals (1.0:1): most light palettes map bright_white to near-white, so the title disappears. Kept as the source emits it.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: ANSI `bright_black`: the . leader between label and duration (`separator_color`). Below 3:1 in both themes (2.9 dark, 2.4 light): a recessive leader that carries no information. Kept as the source emits it.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: The reference cell: every rendered line. ops measures in columns, so one size serves all output.

styles.name: cell-bold
styles.usage: ANSI `bold`: the top-border title, the bottom-border summary and the report title.

styles.name: cell-dense
styles.usage: Specimens in narrow docs columns. Same grid, smaller cell.

styles.name: cell-small
styles.usage: Config keys and captions beside specimens.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Doc and cover titles only. Never in CLI output.

spacing.note: ops lays out in terminal columns. Cell tokens are in em at the 0.6em advance of a monospace face (1 cell = 1ch).

tokens.name: cell-1
tokens.usage: One column: the space after each frame bar, and the gap between icon and label. Studio has `left_pad = 0`: the frame starts at column 0.

tokens.name: cell-2
tokens.usage: `step_indent = "  "` inside the frame, and the gap after the progress cell.

tokens.name: cell-3
tokens.usage: `MIN_SEP_GLYPHS`: the shortest . run between label and duration.

tokens.name: cell-6
tokens.usage: Elapsed field on a running row: `{elapsed:>6}` right-aligns the time in six columns so the right bar never moves.

tokens.name: cell-7
tokens.usage: `BOX_STEP_RESERVE`: the columns the frame and progress column take from every row (`│ █  ` + ` │`). Also the error-block offset.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: One terminal row at the reference cell (about 1.2 × 14px, a typical terminal line height, so │ and ║ join across rows). The frame adds one row above (title) and one below (summary).

tokens.name: frame-pad
tokens.usage: Padding inside a specimen window in docs.

tokens.name: frame-gap
tokens.usage: Space between specimen windows.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything ops draws inside the frame. The frame's own corners are glyphs: rounded outside (╭ ╮ ╰ ╯), square inside (├─ └─).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code chips in docs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Specimen windows in docs.
